all.src: IV rank >= 45; no earnings inside the expiry.
Max loss computed off the WIDE wing must be <= 2% of equity per unit.
IV rank >= 45; no earnings inside the expiry.
All four legs: OI >= 500, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).

management.src: Close at 25% of max profit (the credit) for swing versions.
Close or roll at 21 DTE regardless of P/L.
Stop at 2.0x the credit in mark-to-market loss, computed off the wide side.

exits.src: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: an ATM short call AND an ATM short put both exist; one is ITM at expiry by construction. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if either short leg is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before the ex-date if the short call is ITM with extrinsic below the dividend.
PIN GUARD: close at 15:30 ET if |spot - body| < 0.30% of spot.
